title: Noise Correction on Subjective Datasets
findings: The paper's findings are methodological and not related to religion. It proposes a method for loss-based label correction in a multitask setting for subjective datasets, demonstrating improved performance and robustness to noise. There are no findings specific to religious contexts.

measurement_description: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks or measurements related to faith or religion. The tasks are emotion classification and hate speech detection. A single example text used for illustration contains religious terms ('Christian', 'Satanist') incidentally, but this is not the focus of measurement.
